page.overview:
Who is Alisia?

Alisia was a Human female musician who performed with Alitra, O'choa Detera, Mako, and Mestral in the cantinas aboard both Tansarii Point Station and Nova Orion Station in the Bright Jewel system during the time of the Galactic Civil War. During her time with the band, Alisia played the musical instrument known as the bandfill.

A Human female by the name of Alisia participated in a band during the time of the Galactic Civil War along with two other musicians, a Human named Mako, and a Zabrak named Alitra. Her band also comprised of two dancers, a Twi'lek named Mestral, and a Zabrak named O'choa Detera. Following the Battle of Yavin in 0 BBY, Alisia and her band played music and danced for the patrons of the cantina owned by a Twi'lek named Tiarsis in the Tansarii Point Station, a space station located near the planet of Ord Mantell in the Bright Jewel system. As part of the band, Alisia played the musical instrument known as the bandfill. The Twi'lek entertainer Mira T'rani enjoyed the performance of Alisia's band, which featured two popular songs from Tatooine "Mad About Me" and "Dune Sea Special".

Alisia and her band also divided their time at another space station in the Bright Jewel system known as Nova Orion Station. In addition to the music they played on Tansarii Point Station, Alisia and her band also played two other cover songs belonging to Evar Orbus and His Galactic Jizz-Wailers, including a Huttese song named "Lapti Nek". Despite the band's skill at playing these songs, their lack of original material drew criticism from at least one Nova Orion Industries employee frequenting the cantina.

Alisia had dark skin, brown hair, and amber colored eyes. She was skilled at using the bandfill to play songs such as "Mad About Me" and "Dune Sea Special".
